metadata.title: Sun-Drenched Portrait with Modern Geometric Sans

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, warm-toned portrait featuring a subject positioned off-center with modern, square-proportioned typography placed in the negative space.
triggerTerms: warm skin tones with messy hair
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, intimate close-up of a blonde woman's face shifted to the right third of the frame, characterized by soft, warm sunlight and a blown-out white background. The typography is a distinctive, lowercase geometric sans-serif with squared corners, stacked and aligned to the left of the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right vertical third, creating a large negative space on the left.
Warm skin and hair tones contrast against a neutral, high-key white background.
Typography color is sampled from the darkest and mid-tones of the subject's features.
Messy, textured hair strands overlap the face to create depth and intimacy.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a large-scale headshot positioned on the right side of the frame, cropped at the shoulders and top of the head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye (viewer's left), which is clear and focused amidst the soft hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the lips, then follows the gaze left toward the floating text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the left side provides a clean canvas for the typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep bronze and brown (typography and shadows in hair/eyes)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden blonde and warm peach (mid-tones and skin)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (bright) with moderate saturation in the warm spectrum; low contrast between subject and background edges.
paletteRestrictions: No harsh black; use deep browns for dark values

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric, square-based sans-serif with uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 's' has horizontal top and bottom terminals
The 'p' and 'n' have sharp, right-angled shoulders

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in negative space, not overlapping subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family weight contrast (bold for name, light/regular for title).

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the square, technical, yet modern feel of the 2000s.
Provides the necessary geometric structure and lowercase charm.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, warm-toned portrait of a blonde woman with messy hair, positioned on the right side of the frame against a blown-out white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the left negative space. The first line should be dark brown and the second line slightly indented and in a lighter golden-brown tone.

verificationChecks: Is the subject positioned off-center to the right?
Is the background nearly pure white?
Does the font have a squared-off, geometric appearance?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific artist name or album title from the original image.
Ensure the font is a standard geometric sans and not a proprietary logo font.

avoid: Default Arial or Times New Roman fonts

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not touch the subject.
Ensure the lighting feels like natural sunlight.
Verify the typography is monolinear and geometric.
Confirm the color of the text is derived from the image palette.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Right-aligned subject + Left-aligned square-geometric lowercase typography.
